EmailTemplate.name: B2B_2022_SWL_Nurture.4. ROI of an All-in-One AR Strategy Webinar
EmailTemplate.subject: What’s the cost of your A/R inefficiencies?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}}, Many finance leaders such as yourself are facing fragmented processes in your Accounts Receivable. Whether it’s manual reconciliation, global expansion, or the lack of visibility in overall payment flow and bank fees, inefficient A/R can get very costly.
When it comes to global expansion, 88% of CFOs say their growth is negatively impacted due to the complexities of collecting cross-border payments.
Our team recently presented “The ROI of an All-in-One AR Strategy” <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-the-roi-of-an-all-in-one-ar-strategy?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> where they outlined a holistic approach to A/R that is revolutionizing finance and treasury management. In this webinar recording, we go as far as to outline an ROI analysis of a traditional approach to A/R versus an all-in-one and how it breaks down.
The results? An annual savings of 62%.
Let me know if you’re interested in a personalized ROI assessment for your company,
Thank you, Logan Strickland
